notice: Fictional sample data for demonstration. Lantern Bay, Bayside County and every company, date, number and quote in these documents are made up.
story: A complete deal. All seven terms appear in the staff report, the resolution and the agreement signed by both the City and the owner, and they match.

claims.quote: Staff recommends that the Council adopt the attached resolution approving a 15-year payment in lieu of taxes for Beacon Point.
claims.review_note: This is the public support being asked for.

claims.quote: The owner will reserve 16 of the 80 homes as affordable homes.
Each affordable home must be leased to a household with income at or below 60 percent of area median income.
Rents for the affordable homes may not exceed the 60 percent rent limit based on the HUD income limits published each year.
claims.value: 60 percent rent limit based on HUD income limits
claims.review_note: Rent limit is tied to HUD income limits that change each year.

claims.quote: The affordability requirements will last for 30 years from the date the first affordable home is leased.
The owner, and any later owner of the property, is responsible for meeting these requirements.
The owner will file an annual compliance certificate with the City by March 1 of each year.
If a default is not cured within 60 days after written notice, the owner must repay all abated taxes with interest.
claims.value: Repay abated taxes with interest after 60-day cure period

claims.quote: The City Council approves a payment in lieu of taxes for Beacon Point for a period of 15 years.
16 of the 80 homes are reserved as affordable homes
each affordable home is leased to a household with income at or below 60 percent of area median income
rents do not exceed the 60 percent rent limit based on the HUD income limits published each year
claims.value: 60 percent rent limit based on HUD income limits

the owner and any later owner of the property are responsible for meeting the requirements
the owner files an annual compliance certificate with the City by March 1 of each year
the owner repays all abated taxes with interest if a default is not cured within 60 days after written notice
claims.value: Repay abated taxes with interest after 60-day cure period

claims.quote: The Owner shall pay the City an annual payment in lieu of taxes equal to 25 percent of the property taxes that would otherwise be due, for a period of 15 years.
The Owner shall reserve 16 of the 80 homes in the Project as Affordable Homes.
Each Affordable Home shall be leased to a household with income at or below 60 percent of Area Median Income.
Monthly rent for each Affordable Home, including a utility allowance, shall not exceed the 60 percent rent limit based on the HUD income limits published each year.
claims.value: 60 percent rent limit based on HUD income limits

claims.quote: The requirements of this Article 3 shall remain in effect for 30 years from the date the first Affordable Home is leased.
The Owner is responsible for compliance with this Agreement, and this Agreement binds every later owner of the Project.
The Owner shall deliver an annual compliance certificate to the City by March 1 of each year.
The City shall give the Owner written notice of any default under this Agreement.
If a default is not cured within 60 days after written notice, the Owner shall repay all abated taxes with interest.
claims.value: Repay abated taxes with interest after 60-day cure period
